needsResult.heading: Results to enter
needsResult.clear: All clear · every result is entered.

classements.heading: Current standings
classements.body: View the table fed by finished matches.
classements.empty: The table will appear once matches are finished.

list.noMatchesBody: Open a stage to prepare draws and create matches.

stageList.emptyBody: The structure can exist without attached matches. Prepare the draw on the stage to create them.

detail.startHint: Opens live (0–0 counter). Does not record the official result.
detail.runningScoreHint: Score observed during live. Distinct from the official result.
detail.finishFromLiveHint: The counter is a proposal. You confirm the official result.
detail.finishHint: Records the official result and closes the match.

sheet.heading: Team sheet
sheet.hint: Declared composition for this fixture. Distinct from the score and official result.
sheet.readOnly: The sheet can no longer be edited in this state.
sheet.emptyBody: Add players from the team squad.
sheet.noneEligible: All squad players are already on the sheet.

goals.heading: Goals
goals.hint: Named goal events. Distinct from the live score and official result.
goals.readOnly: Goals can no longer be edited in this state.
goals.needSheet: Add players to the sheet before recording a goal.
goals.emptyBody: Record a named goal from the team sheet.
goals.ownGoalHint: Own goal: credit differs from the scorer’s sheet side. No assister.
goals.runningScoreDesync: The goal is recorded, but updating the live score failed. Reload the displayed state and fix the counter if needed.

subs.heading: Substitutions
subs.hint: Pitch presence events. Distinct from the declarative sheet, the score, and the official result.
subs.readOnly: Substitutions can no longer be edited in this state.
subs.needSheet: Add players to the sheet before recording a substitution.
subs.needStarters: Designate at least one starter on the sheet to derive initial presence.
subs.emptyBody: Record a substitution from presence derived from the sheet.
subs.noOutEligible: No player currently on the pitch on this side.
subs.noInEligible: No player available to come on on this side.

discipline.heading: Discipline
discipline.hint: Named disciplinary events. Distinct from the score, goals, and substitutions. No automatic consequence in V1.
discipline.readOnly: Disciplinary events can no longer be edited in this state.
discipline.needSheet: Add people to the sheet before recording a disciplinary event.
discipline.noneAllowed: No disciplinary type allowed. Configure the competition regulations to allow Yellow, Red, or White.
discipline.emptyBody: Record a card or allowed event from the team sheet.
discipline.memberPlaceholder: Choose a person on the sheet
